name: com.kmj5515.maptool
description:
Grid-based level authoring tool for artists: place, scatter, zones, spawns, validation and JSON export. Core logic is engine-independent C# with EditMode tests. Audio zone authoring turns on automatically when com.kmj5515.audio is installed.

격자 기반 맵 저작 툴(아티스트용): 배치·흩뿌리기·구역·스폰·검증·JSON 내보내기.
